title: Jagati
text:
Jagati may refer to:

A vedic meter
Jagati (temple), a structural element in Indian architecture
Jagati railway station, Kushtia, Bangladesh
Jagathy, a place in Kerala, India
Jagathy Sreekumar, an Indian actor
Jagathy N. K. Achary, an Indian writer
